categories.main_business_segments: Matsui Securities operates primarily as an online securities broker, focusing on providing brokerage services for individual investors. Its main business includes equity and derivatives (futures and options) brokerage, underwriting and distribution of securities, investment trust sales, and FX (foreign exchange margin trading). The company operates as a single business segment centered on online securities trading services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core operations rely on robust, proprietary online trading systems and platforms, including real-time trading tools and mobile applications. System stability, security, and scalability are emphasized, with significant ongoing investment in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity. Matsui outsources some system development and operations to specialized external vendors but maintains strict internal controls and compliance frameworks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Matsui Securities primarily serves individual retail investors in Japan, with a particular focus on beginner to intermediate investors, including a growing segment of younger clients in their 30s and below. The company’s services are tailored to meet diverse customer needs, from active traders to long-term asset builders, and it also offers products for day traders and those interested in U.S. equities and FX trading.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are almost entirely focused on the Japanese domestic market, with all major business activities, customer support, and infrastructure based in Japan. While it offers access to U.S. equities and FX markets, its customer base and physical presence are concentrated in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Matsui Securities operates downstream in the financial services supply chain, acting as a direct interface between financial markets and end-user retail investors. It does not manufacture financial products but distributes, brokers, and provides access to various financial instruments and services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Matsui focuses on enhancing customer experience through stable trading environments, expanding its product lineup, and providing unique, easy-to-understand, and personalized services. The company invests in IT system upgrades, cybersecurity, and digital tools, while also emphasizing brand strength, service quality, and compliance. Although it does not conduct traditional R&D, it continuously develops and improves digital platforms and customer support systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through brokerage commissions (mainly from Japanese equities), interest and fees from margin trading, FX trading profits, and distribution fees from investment trusts. The company is diversifying its revenue streams by expanding into FX, U.S. equities, and banking services, but remains heavily reliant on transaction-based income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Matsui is one of Japan’s five major online securities brokers, competing with SBI Securities, Rakuten Securities, Monex, and Mitsubishi UFJ e-Smart Securities. The industry is highly competitive, with recent moves toward zero-commission trading by some rivals. Matsui differentiates itself through service quality, system reliability, and a strong brand, but faces pressure from larger competitors with greater scale and diversified business models.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, Matsui Securities reported operating revenue of 39.2 billion yen and net income of 10.5 billion yen, with total assets of 1.12 trillion yen and net assets of 76.6 billion yen. The company has shown moderate growth in revenue and profit, with a strong ROE of 13.8%, and maintains a stable financial base with consistent dividend payouts and a focus on capital efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Matsui Securities emphasizes a secure, stable, and user-friendly online trading environment, aiming to make investing accessible, enjoyable, and intellectually engaging for individuals. Its value proposition centers on trustworthiness, simplicity, personalized support, and innovative digital tools, with a strong focus on lowering barriers to entry and providing a wide range of products to meet diverse customer needs.
